message.content:

message.reasoning:

The person must be:
1. A member/associate of the Psychedelic Shamanistic Institute (PSI) founded by Don Barry Mason.
2. Welsh.
3. Died on 10 April 2016.

Looking at the source [Don Barry Mason]:
Associates of PSI include: Mathew Atha, Colin Angus, Brian Barritt, Michael Carmichael, Fraser Clark, Paul Devereux, the late John Entwistle, Paul Flynn MP, Ben Ganly, Lee Harris, Mike Jay, Howard Marks, Dr John Marks, Jonathan Ott, Dr Russell Newcombe, Richard Rudgley and Youth.

Looking at the source [Howard Marks]:
Dennis Howard Marks (13 August 1945 – 10 April 2016) was a Welsh drug smuggler and author...
He is an associate of PSI (listed in the Don Barry Mason source).
He is Welsh.
He died on 10 April 2016.

Therefore, the person is Dennis Howard Marks.
The question asks for their full legal name.
Dennis Howard Marks.
